reviewCharts.warning: Rhode Island review rows are same-key President-versus-U.S.-Senate rows normalized from the official BOE long-format ZIP. Certified President totals reconcile to posted statewide JSON through an explicit non-geographic reconciliation row because the raw ZIP is 32 President votes below posted JSON. U.S. Senate ZIP rows are 29 votes below posted statewide JSON, and 39 presidential-only rows do not have same-key Senate comparison rows. Review rows are advisory source-review signals, not findings. City/town or precinct geometry/crosswalks are not loaded.

turnout.notes: Rhode Island turnout rows still use EAC 2024 V2 city/town jurisdiction fallback rows until a state-native registered-voter denominator artifact is collected and reconciled.

historicalBaselines.warning: Rhode Island historical baseline rows are contextual official BOE city/town and federal-precinct rows for 2012 and 2016. The official 2020 archive ZIP and statewide JSON are collected but not loaded because the 2020 long-format ZIP uses an alternate vote-group layout that did not reconcile in this pass.
